title: Worker Compensation
desc: WorkCover assessments, injury management, return-to-work plans, and coordination with employers and insurers.
detail: Our GPs are experienced in managing workplace injuries and illness. We provide WorkCover medical certificates, capacity assessments, and work closely with employers and insurers to support your recovery.
fullDesc: Workplace injuries can be stressful and disruptive. Our GPs are experienced in managing WorkCover claims and providing the medical support you need to recover and return to work safely. We issue WorkCover medical certificates, perform capacity assessments, and work closely with your employer, insurer, and allied health team to coordinate a smooth recovery. Dr Lwin Mar Aung has particular expertise in worker compensation.
